messages:
Priya Sharma: quick sync — onboarding check for LodeBridge. account trending: 4% higher p95 latency on chat endpoints and token spend up 18% month-over-month. renewal flagged as medium risk. thinking proactive perf play before next QBR: int8 quant pilot + fallback to smaller model family + route heavy traffic to dedicated pool during business hours. thoughts?
Eli Chen: +1 on quant pilot. recommend starting with a small prompt set and AB testing for quality drift. can we decouple by intent? e.g., short transactional vs long generative flows.
Tom Ruiz: curious about cold-start / KV-warmup impact if we change model or quantize. will p95 hurt during canary? need warmup strategy for dedicated pool.
Priya Sharma: yes — plan is: 1) run int8 on non-critical intents for 48h canary, 2) if RMSE/QA metrics < threshold, expand to 25% traffic, 3) enable prefix KV caching + pre-warm tokens at ramp. flagging renewal team to mention cost savings if successful.
Eli Chen: here's a sample canary config I used earlier — small and repeatable:```yaml
canary:
  model: raven-1.3-int8
  traffic: 0.05
  eval_prompts: ["balance_query","refund_status","small_summarize"]
  metrics: [p95_latency, answer_similarity, token_cost_delta]
  rollback: >0.03 answer_similarity_drop
```
Priya Sharma: perfect. can you own running the canary and capturing eval sets? i'll coordinate enablement docs and customer-facing note on expected savings and quality SLA.
Tom Ruiz: i'll set up warmup hooks on the dedicated pool and add a short warm traffic generator for the first 2 hours of rollout. also adding KV-prefetch for top 50 prefixes.
ops-bot: reminder — create incident ticket if p95 spikes > 20% over baseline during canary.
Eli Chen: one more ask — let's capture a small user study for 50 queries to validate perceived quality. i'll draft a short rubric.
Priya Sharma: thanks — action items: @Eli run canary + evals, @Tom warmup + pool routing, @Priya compile renewal note + customer enablement email. i'll update the CS healthboard by EOD. :thumbsup: 
Tom Ruiz: ack.
Eli Chen: on it.
Priya Sharma: leaving a short note for AM: we can present a conservative savings estimate (8–12%) if int8 holds, communicate rollback plan, and propose 30-day checkpoint before renewal conversation.
ops-bot: calendar reminder set: LodeBridge_30d_checkpoint on 1769490000
